title: Sagan in Venus anomaly meeting with White House science adviser
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sagan in Venus anomaly meeting with White House science adviser, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Sean was in the meeting with like the White House science adviser or something like that.
I went down I walked into the room and I knew why because in the room was maybe the most famous venusian Planet scientist that ever lived
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Maguire, who places it in the NSA chief scientist's office during the Clinton years as a tech-transfer meeting, where the story speaks of a White House science adviser.
tellings.link_reason: Maguire's firsthand account of a meeting with Carl Sagan. The story is Michels relaying, from Maguire, a meeting with Sagan and a White House science adviser about a Venus anomaly, so it appears to be the same meeting.

as_told.title: Carl Sagan at NSA chief scientist's tech transfer meeting

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels relays a story, connected to the scientist Carl Sagan and to people named John Brandenburg and Bob Maguire, about a meeting over something unexplained concerning Venus. He says a man called Sean was in that meeting along with the White House science adviser, or someone like that. If true, it would mean puzzles about other planets were being discussed at the top of government.
